seoTitle: Review Reply Generator for Google Business (Templates)
metaDescription: Draft a polite reply to a customer review from its star rating and topics using fill-in templates. Not AI; edit before posting.
intro: Turn a customer review into a first-draft reply that matches the rating, mentions what the reviewer raised and invites follow-up where needed.
why:
The tool reads the review for topics such as service, price, waiting, quality, delivery and cleanliness, and for positive or negative wording. It then fills a template for five-star, three-star or low ratings with your business name, signature, tone (warm or formal) and a contact for resolving problems.

It is a template engine, not a language model, so always add one specific detail from the review before you post. Do not offer compensation in exchange for changing a review, and keep personal information out of public replies.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Paste the review text and set the star rating.
Enter your business name, signature and contact.
Personalise the reply with one concrete detail and publish it.

faq.q: Is the reply written by AI?
faq.a: No. It is assembled from templates using keywords found in the review.

faq.q: Should I reply to negative reviews?
faq.a: Yes, briefly and politely, offering to resolve it offline. Replies are public and read by future customers.

faq.q: Can I use it in other languages?
faq.a: The keyword detection and templates are English only.
No. Everything is processed in your browser, and the page makes no network requests with your input.
